# iStock

> iStock is a royalty-free stock media platform offering millions of high-quality photos, videos, and footage in 4K and HD formats with flexible subscription and credit-based pricing.

iStock provides creators, businesses, and designers with extensive libraries of stock photos and videos across diverse categories including nature, holidays, cultural celebrations, and business themes. The platform supports collaboration boards for creative asset management and curation.

## Key Topics

- royalty-free footage
- stock video library
- 4K and HD video
- subscription plans
- credit packs
- stock photos
- image licensing
- video search
- b-roll content
- pricing tiers
- Planet Earth
- cultural celebrations
- creative curation
- video subscriptions
- asset management
